title: Japanese Style Beer Steeped Beef Wrap
description: A keto twist on traditional beef wraps, infused with Japanese flavors and topped with melted cheese.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine beef slices and Japanese beer. Let it steep for 30 minutes, refrigerated.
2. Preheat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium-high heat. Remove beef from the marinade, letting any excess liquid drip off.
3. Add the beef to the skillet and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until cooked to your desired level of doneness.
4. Meanwhile, warm the low-carb wrap in the microwave for 10-15 seconds.
5. Assemble the wrap by placing the cooked beef on the wrap, followed by melted cheese, green onions, sesame seeds, soy sauce, garlic powder, and black pepper.
7. Optional: Add sliced veggies like bell peppers, carrots, or cucumber for added crunch and nutrients.
8. For an extra crispy wrap, cook it in a skillet for 1-2 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
9. Consider serving with a side of pickled ginger or wasabi for added flavor and fun.
10. Enjoy your keto Japanese style beef wrap!
